class A {
  #value = 1;
  static #count = 0;
  getValue() {
    return this.#value;
  }
  count() {
    return ++A.#count;
  }
}
class B extends A {
  #value = "child";
  static #count = "static child";
  getChildValue() {
    return this.#value;
  }
  static label() {
    return B.#count;
  }
}
const b: A = new B();
console.log(b.getValue(), new B().getChildValue(), b.count(), B.label());
